Are you awesome? We are hiring!

Du wolltest schon immer etwas Großes in einem renommierten Unternehmen bewirken und suchst eine neue berufliche Herausforderung? Dann warte nicht länger und starte Deinen Weg bei Adecco. Wir sind einer der größten Personaldienstleister in einem der spannendsten Märkte unserer Zeit. Seit über 30 Jahren profitieren unsere Geschäftspartner:innen von maßgeschneiderte HR-Lösungen in den Bereichen Personalbeschaffung, Outsourcing, Payroll, Überlassung uvw. Aufgrund des starken und stetigen Wachstums suchen wir für unser humorvolles Beratungsteam, ambitionierte 1 Banking Customer Advisor (m/f/d) Our client is an internationally operating financial institution with a strong focus on excellent customer service. This position is offered on a full-time basis.

Aufgaben

 * You are the first point of contact for members, providing competent, service-oriented and professional support across all their financial needs.

 * You open and manage accounts, process applications and ensure the accurate and efficient handling of all administrative processes.

 * You advise members on banking products and services, particularly account and lending products, and support them in selecting suitable solutions.

 * You calculate loan and interest rates, prepare the relevant documentation and support the processing of loan applications.

 * You ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements and handle sensitive information with the utmost confidentiality.

Profil

 * At least two years of professional experience in private client or retail banking.

 * A solid understanding of regulatory requirements in the banking environment (e.g. account management, financial services, confidentiality and lending), or the willingness and ability to quickly acquire the necessary expertise.

 * Very good command of English, which will be assessed as part of the application process.

 * A passion for delivering excellent customer service and a strong service-oriented mindset. You are able to understand customer needs, build trusting relationships and remain professional and solution-oriented, even in challenging situations.

 * A solution-oriented approach, initiative and a genuine enjoyment of working with people from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Was wir bieten

The position is initially offered on a one-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension thereafter.

The gross annual salary ranges from EUR 57,000 to EUR 60,000 based on full-time employment. The actual remuneration will depend on your qualifications, professional experience and technical expertise.

Kontakt

Are you interested? We look forward to receiving your application documents! Please note that, for data protection reasons, applications for our advertised positions submitted by e-mail cannot be considered or processed.

Ryanair Holdings plc is the parent company of Ryanair DAC, Lauda Europe, Buzz, Malta Air and Ryanair UK. 

DM Aircraft Maintenance are the dedicated engineering maintenance provider based in Vienna, Austria providing comprehensive maintenance on the Lauda Europe A320 and Ryanair B737 fleet of aircraft.

We are currently seeking an experienced Car Mechanic to maintain and repair our company vehicles and assist with general housekeeping and maintenance at our VIE hangar facility when vehicle maintenance work is not required.

The successful candidate will work with our dedicated team of engineering professionals in Vienna. 1 In-House Car Mechanic Reports to: Hangar Manager

Working Time: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

The Role & Responsibilities:

 * Inspect, diagnose, and repair mechanical and electrical faults in company vehicles.

 * Perform routine servicing and preventive maintenance to keep the fleet safe and reliable.

 * Respond to breakdowns and prioritise repairs to minimise vehicle downtime.

 * Maintain accurate service records and track upcoming maintenance requirements.

 * Identify and order spare parts, and coordinate specialist repairs when needed.

 * When vehicle work is not required, assist with minor facility repairs, workshop upkeep, and other practical duties within your skills and training.

 * Keeping the Hangar facility in a functional and organised condition.

 * Any other duties / tasks as requested by your Supervisor / Manager.

 

Skills and Requirements:

 * Approximately 3-5 years of hands-on automotive maintenance and repair experience.

 * Relevant automotive qualification, trade certificate, or equivalent recognised experience.

 * Strong knowledge of vehicle mechanical and electrical systems, with experience using diagnostic tools.

 * Attention to detail and problem solving.

 * Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and communicate repair requirements clearly.

 * Practical handyman skills, a safety-focused approach, and willingness to support general maintenance duties.

 * Driver's license B.

 * German speaking essential.

 * English speaking desirable.

 * Good communication and organisation skills.

 * Must have a flexible approach to working in a fast-paced changing environment.

 * All applicants must have the right to live and work in Austria / EU.

Salary: TBC €3.000,00
